correctness.rationale: Inspected the exact 21 listed integral 3-vectors, the 37 supporting 3D facet planes, all 37^2=1369 side facets and two base facets of the specified 8D free-sum/pyramid embedding. The seven active side normals with positive weights 14,3/2,3/2,1,1,9,9 plus base weights 111,74 cancel every center coordinate, giving R<=222/(257+14sqrt15+3sqrt23+2sqrt770). A symmetric center satisfies seven active equalities; an independent enumeration of all 37 facets and 1362 nonactive side slacks produced positive minimum slack 0.002278226939043... . The original VERIFY.py implements exact rational sqrt intervals via isqrt, not just floating comparisons; its code was read. Differences of three swapped active pairs have determinant 148, fixing the two 3-blocks and establishing uniqueness. The max squared facet normal 1525 gives origin-centered ball radius 1/sqrt1525. Independent high-precision approximate checks corroborate exact analytical inequalities; this exhaustive finite construction is self-contained for one specified polytope, not an infinite family.
